name: Villa d'Este
insider_take: This legendary 16th-century villa turned palatial hotel sits majestically on Lake Como's shores, where royalty, celebrities, and discerning travelers have sought refuge for over 150 years.
whats_special: Villa d'Este boasts one of the world's most spectacular floating pool, built directly on Lake Como itself. The hotel's 25 acres of Renaissance gardens are considered among Italy's finest, featuring ancient cypress trees, ornate fountains, and rare botanical specimens. Each room offers breathtaking lake or garden views, with many retaining original frescoes and period furnishings.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on the piano nobile (noble floor) for the most authentic villa experience, and time your stay during the Concorso d'Eleganza vintage car show in May for an unforgettable spectacle.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's private speedboat to explore Lake Como's hidden grottos and villa-dotted coastline. The on-site COMO Shambhala Spa offers treatments in a floating pavilion, while the Michelin-starred Veranda restaurant serves exceptional Italian cuisine with panoramic lake vistas. Evening aperitivos on the lakeside terrace are simply magical as the sun sets behind the Alps.
pros: Legendary 16th-century villa with unparalleled Lake Como waterfront location
World-renowned floating pool on Lake Como with spectacular mountain views
Exceptional fine dining experiences including Michelin-starred cuisine
Impeccable white-glove service and attention to detail throughout
cons: Formal dress codes required in main dining areas
